summary: Close the RDC open-circuit recovery gap, preserve verified recovery after terminal failure, and restore the approved production Sol/Luna/Google Free diagnostic path.
reason: A transient outbound dependency outage exhausted deterministic RDC restart attempts while the dependency remained unavailable. The open circuit never half-opened after connectivity returned, the production diagnose CLI excluded Google Free despite the approved policy, and failed incidents could not later emit canonical recovery.

tests.name: runtime-focused-regression
tests.evidence: 67 focused Python tests passed; incident runtime hardening shell PASS; 9 Node remote/local health assertions PASS.

tests.name: rdc-managed-repair-live-recurrence
tests.evidence: Old runtime reproduced presence-online/external-ping-timeout during correction; existing managed repair recovered one functionally healthy RDC instance in 17.621 s and external ping subsequently passed. This validates the observed gap, not candidate activation.

tests.name: ui-playbooks-full-final-regression
tests.evidence: 832 tests passed on the final frozen UI Playbooks candidate after documentation, registry and production CLI test updates.

capabilities.reason: RDC gains bounded half-open recovery using its existing controller; engineering diagnostics regain the already-approved provider-independent fallback on the real production entrypoint.

architecture.reason: Extends existing watchdog, controller, Incident Orchestrator and provider policy only; no daemon, scheduler, store, router or mutation authority is added.

rollback: Promote the prior immutable Tier0 release, retain incident/model evidence, and revert the scoped private runtime commit after checking concurrent work.
limitations: The lower-level network trigger for the 05:45 outage is not proven; only the cross-service outbound dependency failure is evidenced.
Anonymous endpoint reachability authorizes a bounded retry only; it never establishes RDC health.
Candidate source is not production until immutable activation and external E2E acceptance complete.
